name: setup-keleres-preset-repress
description: Keleres preset loop (regress pbd1967 / pbd1195; bot drafts e.g. pbd196 x95): the draft-time preset (draftPresetKeleres_<flavor>, setup.keleres_flavor preset=true) re-posts its buttons after every press, so it never closes by being answered and a scripted seat re-pressed it every few seconds. pbd75@14 (Bot Eta = seat2 just drafted Keleres, draft still running): presetting Xxcha is answered; pressing Xxcha again on the re-posted prompt is refused ('already your preset', value.current) while the prompt stays open to change the preset.
